$comment: Regression fixture for the per-agent model-override merge delta (model-catalog-revamp
registry-state.ts, `mergeAgentsForDisplay`) mirrors the SHAPE of the server's
`{model, effort}` cells instead of a bare tier string. It is exercised only from the
apps/web-ui suite (admin-handlers.test.ts) — the server side no longer shares this
literal fixture (its own `model-profiles.test.ts` covers the same merge with its own
cases) — but the case shape below stays a documented contract for what a correct
Cases covered, one per agent key:
builder   — inherit one host's cell (claude), override another's whole cell (opencode)
navigator — whole-agent null tombstone: removed entirely from the merged result
reviewer  — host-level null tombstone: its only host key is removed, agent entry
survives as an empty object (deletion is scoped to the host key, not the
agent — mirrors mergeFlatMap's per-key tombstone semantics one level up)
planner   — a genuinely new agent the builtin never named, added wholesale by the
overlay (no agent list in the registry principle — this is opt-in data)
